message.content: The yellowing started about four days ago and has been getting worse gradually. I've been feeling very tired and lightheaded too. My stools have been dark. I don't have any itching, abdominal pain, swelling, nausea, vomiting, or fever. I haven't noticed any unusual weight loss either.
